classes.label: Established exact
classes.summary: Finite identities, declared transforms and reconstruction contracts that are exact inside their stated domains.
items: Exact CRT and finite representation returns
Declared involutions, quotient counts and return keys
Bounded G0→G1→G2 relation-object preservation
Aligned finite multi-view relation-state reconstruction
Conditional signed reciprocal return: (Q'_epsilon)^2 = epsilon I under the explicit bridge contract
classes.claim_boundary: Exactness inside one declared construction does not establish universality, causality or physical meaning.

classes.label: Bounded method findings
classes.summary: Executable procedures that survived registered tests while retaining explicit scope and information-loss boundaries.
items: Carrier–View–Residual separation transferred across two distinct carriers
Transition & Identifiability eight-field inspection grammar
Translation-fidelity robustness/detail/discrimination trade-off
Three aligned lossy views reveal a relation state while source ambiguity remains
Oriented seam and local signatures separate the finite A0-BL-035 population, but do not compress it
classes.claim_boundary: These are method findings, not new Prime theory, a cellular-automaton law or a physical invariant.

classes.label: Valid negative and boundary
classes.summary: Registered failures and non-identities that narrow the programme and prevent visual or numerical coincidence from becoming mechanism.
items: No Life/E8 identity or E8-specific Life mechanism established
No prime-specific coding advantage under registered controls
Mod 17 did not retain unique status in controlled comparison
Original n+1 contribution claim not supported against prior art and fair-information baseline
A0-BL-021 terminal structure is path-dependent; the 7×8 address grid is not canonically identical to the 56-class quotient
A0-BL-035 found no compressed sufficient Splinter selector
A0-BL-045 local Q5 data does not determine the seam topology, and algebraic signed return does not imply Euclidean isometry
classes.claim_boundary: A negative result applies to its frozen question and does not prohibit every differently specified successor.

classes.label: Historical and provenance
classes.summary: Visuals, books, HTML instruments, GLBs and named number families that explain question formation without becoming independent validation.
items: Prime, base, modulus, grid and mode lineages
E8, root, orbit and projection demonstrations
Glyph, visual and 3D object provenance
Historical programme vocabulary and source-local interpretations
classes.claim_boundary: Historical recurrence and attractive form are research prompts, not evidence of a common operator or mechanism.

classes.label: Open frontiers
classes.summary: Questions with a declared path toward proof, falsification, external replication or explicit STOP.
items: Minimum observation family that separates admitted source pairs
Invariant descent to observational-equivalence quotients
Exact or bounded commutation of alternative representation paths
External replication of the translation-fidelity trade-off
Stable return-capable multi-view relation versus alternative mappings
classes.claim_boundary: An open frontier is not an admitted or active research cycle.

frontier.title: Relational identifiability under representation change
frontier.human_question: What remains genuinely stable when the same carrier is represented differently, and when do view, cut or coupling merely create the appearance of new structure?
frontier.hypothesis: For one fixed carrier, declared views and operators, a non-trivial relational signature can remain stable across multiple non-identical views, distinguish coupling or transition from view-induced adjacency under matched controls, and support a declared return.
minimum_test: Fix one finite carrier and admissible view family
Declare direct and composed representation paths
Use relabeling, alternative-map, no-coupling and lossy-view controls
Measure preservation, fibers, residual and return separately
Require holdout or theorem-level closure before promotion
fail_conditions: Signature depends on an arbitrary cut
Return fails under the declared contract

owner_selection.next_permitted_action: Select the strongest standard fair-information baseline and prepare one admission-ready Gate-5 Intake with comparator, controls, STOP rule, preregistration and Run Contract.

readiness_gates.label: Stable across non-identical representations
readiness_gates.evidence: CA-IDENT-09/10 and related controlled-view records preserve declared identity and target relations across bounded cuts.

readiness_gates.label: Survives null and alternative models
readiness_gates.evidence: Registered relabeling, alternative-map, no-coupling and lossy-view controls include informative negative results.

readiness_gates.label: Predicts unknown or held-out data
readiness_gates.evidence: Some internal holdouts exist, but no general external out-of-sample prediction has been established.

readiness_gates.label: Reconstructs a known carrier or state
readiness_gates.evidence: Aligned finite views reconstruct declared relation states; provenance and universality remain unresolved.

readiness_gates.label: Beats a standard method measurably
readiness_gates.evidence: No fair-information advantage against the strongest relevant standard baseline has yet been demonstrated.

readiness_gates.label: Is independently reproduced
readiness_gates.evidence: No independent external reproduction is registered; this gate follows a successful Gate-5 result.

claim_ceiling: Owner selection authorizes preparation only. No new mathematical field, theorem, universal invariant, physical mechanism, cross-domain identity, Study admission, research activation, execution or publication is asserted. Potential methodological novelty requires literature review, a fair baseline and external replication.
